summary_ja: 最終指定親会社が金融庁長官の承認を受けた場合にシナリオ法を用いることができ、承認後は継続して用いることを定める。
summary_en: Provides that an Ultimate Designated Parent Company may use the scenario method with the approval of the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency and must keep using it unless approval is revoked.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company may use the scenario method where it has obtained the approval of the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency.

An Ultimate Designated Parent Company that has obtained the approval under the preceding paragraph shall continue to use the scenario method, except where the approval is revoked pursuant to the provisions of Article 279-5.
